item.description: The papers today together sketch a move from describing isolated parts of biological systems to engineering or predicting how those parts behave together over time and across scales. | At the same time, structural prediction is stepping beyond single‑chain models. | Functional discovery is likewise gaining a multi‑modal perspective.
